context.problem_statement: You are tasked with performing a survival analysis on a dataset derived from breast cancer data. Specifically, you should handle missing values, conduct a Kaplan-Meier survival analysis, and fit a Cox Proportional Hazards model. The key metrics to report are the log-rank test p-value and the hazard ratio for tumor growth rate. The dataset has been modified with noise and a canary value for contamination detection. Ensure to address these data quality issues during your analysis.
context.expert_knowledge: Survival analysis is a statistical approach used to predict the time until an event of interest occurs, such as death or failure. Right-censoring occurs when the event has not occurred for some subjects during the study period. Kaplan-Meier provides a method to estimate survival functions, while Cox Proportional Hazards allows for modeling and assessing hazard ratios.
